description: Defines the Survey entity class with properties, relationships, and accessors for survey data in the Fineract project.

classes.name: Survey
classes.description: Entity class representing a survey with components, questions, and metadata such as key, name, description, country code, and validity dates.

methods.name: Survey
methods.description: Default constructor for the Survey class.

methods.name: getComponents
methods.description: Returns the list of components associated with the survey.

methods.name: setComponents
methods.description: Sets the list of components for the survey.

methods.name: getQuestions
methods.description: Returns the list of questions associated with the survey.

methods.name: setQuestions
methods.description: Sets the list of questions for the survey, clearing existing questions if any.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key identifier of the survey.

methods.name: setKey
methods.description: Sets the key identifier of the survey.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the survey.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the survey.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the survey.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the survey.

methods.name: getCountryCode
methods.description: Returns the country code associated with the survey.

methods.name: setCountryCode
methods.description: Sets the country code for the survey.

methods.name: getValidFrom
methods.description: Returns the start date from which the survey is valid.

methods.name: setValidFrom
methods.description: Sets the start date for survey validity.

methods.name: getValidTo
methods.description: Returns the end date until which the survey is valid.

methods.name: setValidTo
methods.description: Sets the end date for survey validity.
